2610.09205.title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
2610.09205.paper_summary: Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift. This gap shows that high in-distribution accuracy partly reflects cues tied to rendering and counterfactual construction.
2610.09205.paper_summary_zh: 現代影像編輯模型可以滿足文本指令，同時違反編輯場景的物理法則。新的物體可能不會投下陰影，鏡子可能無法反射可見的幾何形狀，或者一個物體可能懸浮在應該支撐它的表面上。我們研究物理合理性診斷，檢測編輯後的影像是否違反場景物理，命名違規類型，定位受影響區域，並用語言解釋失敗。我們引入了一個反事實基準，其受控的合成組件使用 Mitsuba~3 生成 5,500 張來自 500 個場景家族的影像。每個家族包含一張乾淨的影像和十個涉及陰影、反射、支撐、表面反應和遮擋的匹配違規。渲染管道提供類別標籤、受影響區域的掩碼和框、場景元數據和解釋目標。我們使用 LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 InternVL3.5-8B 作為診斷基準，而不是提出的方法。在一個包含 1,650 張影像的合成測試集上，調整後的基準在標準保留場景上達到 64.0--67.8\% 的類別宏觀 F1。對於 LLaVA-1.5-7B，類別宏觀 F1 從標準分割的 64.0\% 下降到介入轉移下的 40.8\%。這一差距顯示，高分佈內準確率部分反映了與渲染和反事實構建相關的線索。
